topic: Automatic Lighting System Activation and Deactivation Logic
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific condition-action pair for the automatic lighting system, detailing the trigger conditions and corresponding actions taken by the system.

core_entities.name: Automatic Lighting Module
core_entities.description: The central module responsible for managing the automatic lighting functions.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Lighting and Hazard Warning Control Unit, involved in controlling fog lights and other exterior lighting.

core_entities.name: ICB
core_entities.description: Integrated Control Board, used for signal conversion and control of position and near lights.

core_entities.name: HMI
core_entities.description: Human-Machine Interface, used to display the status of automatic lighting.

core_conditions.name: Automatic Lighting Status
core_conditions.description: Indicates whether the automatic lighting function is active or inactive.

core_conditions.name: Sunlight/Rain Sensor Mode
core_conditions.description: Switches between nighttime and daytime modes based on environmental conditions.

core_conditions.name: Fog Light Status
core_conditions.description: Controls the on/off state of front and rear fog lights.

core_conditions.name: Vehicle Motion State
core_conditions.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is in TRANSPORT mode (moving) or stationary.

core_conditions.name: User Setting Modes
core_conditions.description: Different user-defined settings such as Sleep, Standby, and XOTA (eXtended Operation Time Adjustment).

core_outputs.name: Exterior Light Switch Process
core_outputs.description: Controls the overall status of exterior lights, including combination lights, fog lights, and side position lights.

core_outputs.name: CAN Signal
core_outputs.description: Signal sent to the ICB for converting service/control signals into CAN format for further processing.

core_outputs.name: Dipped Beam Request Status
core_outputs.description: Status indicating whether the dipped beam (low beam) is requested or not.

core_outputs.name: HMI Display
core_outputs.description: Displays the current status of automatic lighting functions to the driver.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the logic for activating and deactivating the automatic lighting system based on various input conditions, such as vehicle motion, user settings, and environmental sensors. It specifies the actions taken by different controllers (LHZCU, ICB) to ensure proper operation of exterior lights under different scenarios.
